definitions: The process of forming a hybrid, especially a genetic hybrid.
The process of interbreeding individuals from different species or genetically distinct populations to produce a hybrid.
The process of combining two complementary single-stranded DNA or RNA molecules to form a single double-stranded molecule.
examples: The hybridization of different plant species led to new varieties.
DNA hybridization is a key technique in molecular biology.
Cultural hybridization can be observed in many societies.
